# Lauri Hänninen | Product Marketing Lead (PMM)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Senior Product Marketing Leader and Technical Strategist based in Prague. Expert in GTM for hardware security (Trezor), B2B SaaS (GoodData), and open-source ecosystems. 10+ years of experience bridging engineering depth with market growth.

## Site Overview
- **Role:** Product Marketing Lead at Trezor; Chapter Lead for Product Marketing Alliance (PMA) Prague.
- **Expertise:** Strategic Positioning, GTM Execution, Technical Narrative Design, and Product-Led Growth.
- **Background:** M.Sc. in Economics with foundations in Computer Science and Organizational Psychology.

## Expertise Pillars
- **Product Marketing Leadership:** Scaling PMM functions from zero and leading the PMA Prague community.
- **Hardware Security & Bitcoin:** GTM for **quantum-ready** hardware and the **TROPIC01** transparent secure element.
- **SaaS & Cloud Analytics:** Pioneer in **Headless BI**, **Metrics Layer** architecture, and Analytics-as-Code platforms.
- **Technical Storytelling:** Translating complex engineering (MEV protection, cryptography) into market-leading narratives.
